name: VSN F-80C Shooting Star
summary: VSN team's free F-80C Shooting Star early jet fighter for DCS World.
description:
Free VSN mod adding the Lockheed F-80C Shooting Star with a custom model (based on purchased file404 data) and FC3-style cockpit. Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)
